title: Manual Dispatch Authorization — CAD Down

transcript.speaker: Incident Commander
transcript.text: This is Director Voss. I’ve just confirmed with County Security that AD access is not required for manual dispatch operations. The floor is using RCECD-F-11 run cards and field radio only — no AD dependency. We proceed to manual dispatch under RCECD-OPS-2026 Section 7. I authorize the shift to go to cards and begin tracking unit status on the whiteboard and printed map book.

transcript.speaker: Floor Supervisor
transcript.text: Understood, Director. Initiating manual dispatch procedures now. All call takers will begin writing calls on RCECD-F-11 and using the printed map book for location verification. Unit status will be updated via radio only.

instructorNote: This inject confirms the shift's decision to go to manual mode. Watch for the Supervisor to initiate card-based dispatch and verify that the whiteboard and map book are used for status tracking.
